gates.note: the brake is fixed (bone muzzle_device, joint fixed to barrel)

method: c3 + q34 as the shape authority, side views (L2) for X/Z: c3 part camera re-solved on the brake only; slot widths / web measured against the reference's OWN rim in c3 (back-projection through that camera) and placed against our rim; face plane from the LEFT trace through the face top and the chin; iterations r2_i1..i6 + final r2 in review/detail/muzzle_brake/ (pair / edges / result per tag)
method_changes: no threaded rear ring, no raised bead: one convexly flared body r 10.0 -> 10.5
bullnose rim (outer + inner Bezier rounds meet on the face, no flat band) on a conical chamber r 6.7 -> 7.5 (wall 3.4 top -> 3.0 chin)
chin = one long round (tangent 5.5 along the body), no flat, front X 879.9 @ Z -9.0
slot narrow (4.7 / 6.6 / 8.2 wide), Z -5.9..7.2, rear lean 11 deg, front 25 deg, web 2.2 / 4.3 / 6.1 (r1: 11.8 wide at Z 0, web 1.8 parallel to the cut)
detent knob: small dome at the junction X 847.4-852.4, crown Z 11.15 (r1: notched rectangular clip 847.6-853.6 on a separate ring)
loft samples trimmed (K_OUT 2, K_CH 1) to stay under the r1 / form triangle count
known_differences: proportion (cannot be fixed within L2): c3 draws the brake ~35 % shorter relative to its height than the side views (straight top ~11 mm vs the side views' ~16-18 mm); q34 draws it ~5 mm LONGER. The side views (L2 authority) keep X 848.82-880 / dia ~20-21, so in the c3 crop our body still runs out of the window's left edge: the round-1 'long tube' tell is reduced (flare, taller mouth, brake-only framing) but not gone

front sight junction: the reference shows sleeve -> one narrow collar -> brake body (step UP); ours shows the FSB's r 10.1 collar then the brake (r 10.0 at the rear face). Proposal to the front_sight owner in spec_proposal.json (front collar r ~9.4)
render tells remain by design of the ROUGH LOOK: no wear / pitting / bright worn edges on the rim crown, darker chamber interior
the knob sits ~4 mm further forward than c3 draws it (c3: over the FSB collar); the side views show nothing above the collar there, so the L2 contour (max <= 2 px) caps its overhang at ~1.4 mm
